versions.content: The DEN basic service is triggered by the V2x-Application via its service operations TriggerEvent, UpdateEvent or TerminateEvent from the service interface V2xFacDenBs (see chapter 8.7.2.1). The function parameter “EventID” given by the above mentioned operations shall be mapped by the DEN basic service to the actionID generated for DENMs. For details see [11] chapter 5.3 and 8.2
